text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Sigh… I can't believe I'm failing five subjects!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Now I've got three hours of extra classes every day…

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Things are looking desperate! Not only will I have to stop being an Umadol, but I might even get held back!
Smart Falcon's cry for help really hits home, but unfortunately, there's nothing I can do…
